comment: Pinned model weights for the local RTX 5090 stack. Folders are relative to the models volume and mirror ComfyUI's models/ layout; the voice and transcription services read their own folders. Sizes and sha256 values come from the Hugging Face file listings (LFS oids). No LTX, Wan or other non-MiniMax video model is listed, by policy (the Wan2.1 VAE of eval-joyai-image-edit is an image latent codec only, not a video generator).

groups.name: video-minimax-h3
groups.purpose: Local MiniMax H3 (open weights) for ComfyUI: first/last-frame-to-video-with-audio, pruned int8 for 32 GB cards, nvfp4 text encoder, VAEs, turbo LoRAs.

groups.name: images-qwen
groups.purpose: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (multi-reference editing: character sheets, location views, storyboard frames) and Qwen-Image-2512 (text-to-image), Apache-2.0, fp8 for 32 GB.

groups.name: images-qwen-identity
groups.purpose: The MediaPipe face detector (models/detection) for the Image Reference read: the face box of the producer's picture and the face crop given to the redraw. Apache-2.0, 5.4 MB; fetched once into the models volume with a one-off container (docs/MODELS.md).

groups.name: images-vlm
groups.purpose: Qwen3.5-4B (Apache-2.0) as a vision-language model inside core ComfyUI (CLIPLoader → TextGenerate): describes the producer's uploaded picture in Image Reference mode so the canonical character image's identity line is read from the picture, not invented (docs/CONTRACTS-IDENTITY-PACK.md v2 §2). ~9.3 GB. Fetch on its own: MODEL_GROUPS=images-vlm.

groups.name: asr-whisper
groups.purpose: faster-whisper large-v3 (CTranslate2 fp16) for transcript validation and subtitle timing; MIT.

groups.name: eval-qwen-image-2.1
groups.purpose: EVALUATION ONLY (docs/research/MODEL-STACK-2026-10.md §3.11): Qwen-Image-2.1 int8 DiT + Qwen3-VL-8B int8 text encoder + its VAE, 17.3 GB, under the Qwen Research Licence (research or evaluation purposes only; a commercial use needs a separate licence from Alibaba). Never in the default MODEL_GROUPS and never a studio default: the A/B of docs/research/MODEL-EVAL-2026-10.md compares it against Qwen-Image-2512 so the producer can decide whether to request a licence. Fetch on its own: --groups eval-qwen-image-2.1.

groups.name: eval-joyai-image-edit
groups.purpose: CANDIDATE (docs/research/MODEL-EVAL-2026-10.md §7, model-upgrade directive 2026-10-06 §2): JoyAI-Image-Edit (JD, jdopensource/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus-ComfyUI repackaged by Comfy-Org), 16B MMDiT + Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder, Apache-2.0, up to 6 reference images (core node TextEncodeJoyImageEdit, ComfyUI 0.38.1). int8_convrot DiT + int8_convrot text encoder, 26.75 GB. The Wan2.1 VAE is used ONLY as JoyAI's image latent codec; no Wan video model is installed or used. Benchmarked against FLUX.2 klein 4B (reference identity) and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (placement, location views); not in the default MODEL_GROUPS until promoted: --groups eval-joyai-image-edit.

groups.name: eval-qwen-image-2512-bf16
groups.purpose: CANDIDATE (docs/research/MODEL-EVAL-2026-10.md §7): Qwen-Image-2512 at full precision (bf16, 40.86 GB) against the shipping fp8_e4m3fn cast; Apache-2.0. The DiT is larger than the 32 GB card, so ComfyUI loads it partially and streams the rest from host RAM. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS until promoted: --groups eval-qwen-image-2512-bf16.

groups.name: stack-2026-10
groups.purpose: Model stack of October 2026 (docs/research/MODEL-STACK-2026-10.md §7): whisper-large-v3-arabic-dialectal-v2 (oddadmix, Apache-2.0, a large-v3 fine-tune on 13 Arabic dialects; Iraqi WER 0.254 / CER 0.068 on its held-out set) in transformers format, 6.17 GB, pinned to one revision. The asr service does not read this folder: a one-off conversion (`docker compose --profile models run --rm asr-convert`) writes the CTranslate2 fp16 copy into asr/whisper-large-v3-arabic-dialectal-v2-ct2, which ASR_MODEL_DIR_AR points at. Gemma 4 31B-it is NOT here: Ollama pulls it into the ollama volume (compose service llm-pull). Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=stack-2026-10.

groups.name: music-ace-step
groups.purpose: ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo (MIT) with the 1.7B language model: songs with vocals from lyrics, Arabic listed as a supported language.

groups.name: video-minimax-h3-reference
groups.purpose: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video (up to 9 reference images, video and audio references) and its 4-step turbo LoRA.

groups.name: voice-design
groups.purpose: The tts-design service (:8022): VoxCPM2 (OpenBMB, 2 B, Apache-2.0) designs a synthetic voice from a text description (EN, AR-MSA; 48 kHz), and the ECAPA-TDNN speaker encoder (SpeechBrain, VoxCeleb, Apache-2.0) gives 192-d embeddings for similarity and cast distinctness. Pinned to the repo revisions below. audiovae.pth and the ECAPA .ckpt files are PyTorch pickles: they are loaded only inside the tts-design container (torch.load weights_only). Fetch once: docs/MODELS.md.

groups.name: eval-voice-dots
groups.purpose: EVALUATION (voice benchmark, docs/research/VOICE-BENCH-2026-10.md): dots.tts-soar (rednote-hilab, 2 B, Apache-2.0 per the HF card and the GitHub LICENSE; Seed-TTS-eval EN WER 1.30 / SIM 77.1 as published), the voice-cloning checkpoint, 48 kHz continuous-latent AR + flow head, CAM++ x-vector encoder and vocoder in the repo. Served by the bench service docker/tts-bench (target dots, :8041), never by the live tts services. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: --groups eval-voice-dots. 4.81 GB.

groups.name: eval-voice-moss
groups.purpose: EVALUATION (voice benchmark, docs/research/VOICE-BENCH-2026-10.md): MOSS-TTS v1.5 (OpenMOSS, 8 B MossTTSDelay on Qwen3-8B, Apache-2.0 per the HF card) with its MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer (Apache-2.0, 24 kHz, 32 codebooks): zero-shot cloning, token-level duration control (tokens=N) and [pause X.Ys] markers. The repos carry Python modelling code loaded with trust_remote_code: it is pinned here by revision and read before use. Served by docker/tts-bench (target moss, :8042). Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: --groups eval-voice-moss. 22.4 GB.

groups.name: sfx-moss-soundeffect
groups.purpose: MOSS-SoundEffect (OpenMOSS, 8 B MossTTSDelay, Apache-2.0 per the HF card) for ambience, crowds, footsteps, doors and cinematic effects (PRODUCTION-STACK-DIRECTIVE 2026-10-06, Music Video and narrative sections). Same architecture and modelling code as MOSS-TTS v1.5 and the SAME audio tokenizer (tts/bench/moss-audio-tokenizer, group eval-voice-moss): served by the tts-bench-moss image with an ambient_sound prompt. Python modelling code is loaded with trust_remote_code from this pinned revision. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: --groups sfx-moss-soundeffect. 15.58 GB.

groups.name: qa-align
groups.purpose: Script forced alignment in the asr service (POST /align, docker/asr/align.py; docs/research/FILM-PIPELINE-RESEARCH-2026-10-05.md §B.2): wav2vec2 CTC emissions + a numpy re-implementation of WhisperX's trellis/backtrack (BSD-2, not the whisperx package). EN facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h (~0.38 GB), AR jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-arabic (~1.26 GB). Licences ◐ (Apache-2.0 per search summaries only). Revision, bytes and sha256 pinned from the first workstation fetch (2026-10-06). align.py needs config.json, vocab.json, preprocessor_config.json and pytorch_model.bin (or model.safetensors). MMS / ctc-forced-aligner weights are CC-BY-NC and are NOT used. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=qa-align.

groups.name: qa-identity
groups.purpose: Face identity QA in the asr service, CPU (POST /qa/identity, docker/asr/qa.py; research §D): OpenCV Zoo YuNet 2023mar face detector (MIT ✔, opencv_zoo models/face_detection_yunet/LICENSE) and SFace 2021dec face embedder (Apache-2.0 ✔, models/face_recognition_sface/LICENSE), used through cv2.FaceDetectorYN / cv2.FaceRecognizerSF; SFace cosine, START threshold 0.363. Same files and folder as the copies already on the volume since 2026-10-03 (docs/MODELS.md), so a fetch only verifies them; sizes and sha256 re-checked 2026-10-05 against the opencv_zoo LFS objects. No InsightFace. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=qa-identity.

groups.name: music-ace-step-xl
groups.purpose: The production song stack (PRODUCTION-STACK-DIRECTIVE 2026-10-06 §2–3): ACE-Step 1.5 XL-SFT (4 B DiT, the final song generator; ComfyUI template audio_ace_step1_5_xl_sft: 50 steps, cfg 7, AuraFlow shift 3), the ACE-Step 5Hz LM 4B (the composition/audio-code language model, loaded as the second ACE text encoder qwen_4b_ace15) and ACE-Step 1.5 XL-Base (repaint / cover / extend / extract / completion; template audio_ace_step1_5_xl_base: 50 steps, cfg 6). Needs the VAE and the 0.6B text encoder of group music-ace-step. Licence: MIT on the upstream cards (ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-sft d06de46b, ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-base 220c1166, ACE-Step/acestep-5Hz-lm-4B 0a3ec94b; ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 states commercial use of generated music) — read 2026-10-06; these are Comfy-Org's single-file repackages of the same weights (repo card apache-2.0). Revision, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids). 28.3 GB. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: --groups music-ace-step-xl.

groups.name: lipsync-latentsync-1.6
groups.purpose: The lip-sync corrector (docker/lipsync, compose profile `lipsync`; docs/MODELS.md): LatentSync 1.6 U-Net (ByteDance, CreativeML Open RAIL++-M per the model card, read 2026-10-06: commercial use allowed, the Attachment A use restrictions must pass downstream into any terms of use), Whisper tiny (OpenAI, MIT; the file in the LatentSync repo is byte-identical to OpenAI's tiny.pt, whose URL carries this sha256) and the SD VAE ft-MSE (Stability AI, MIT per the card, read 2026-10-06). Code: github bytedance/LatentSync @ a229c39 (Apache-2.0), fetched by the image build. NOT fetched: the repo's auxiliary/ files (sfd_face.pth, syncnet_v2.model, vgg16, i3d, koniq, vit_g: unstated or third-party licences) and no InsightFace pack (non-commercial). Needs qa-identity (YuNet, SFace) and the Face Landmarker (service_fetched below). Revisions, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids) on 2026-10-06. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=lipsync-latentsync-1.6.

files.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper tiny, byte-identical to openai's release)

groups.name: lipsync-eval-syncnet
groups.purpose: EVALUATION ONLY: LatentSync 1.6's StableSyncNet (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M, same card as the corrector), a sync-confidence scorer for before/after comparisons of corrected takes. Not used by the studio's pipeline. 1.6 GB; fetch only when an evaluation uses it: MODEL_GROUPS=lipsync-eval-syncnet.

groups.name: llm-qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4
groups.purpose: THE PRODUCTION PLANNER RUNTIME on the single RTX 5090 (producer model-stack correction 2026-10-07): Inferact/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, a ModelOpt NVFP4 quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (Apache-2.0 per the card and LICENSE, not gated, read 2026-10-07; lm_head, embeddings and the linear-attention input projections kept unquantized per hf_quant_config.json). vLLM recipe for one RTX 5090: --max-model-len 32768, --kv-cache-dtype fp8, --enforce-eager, --reasoning-parser qwen3. nvfp4_experts_mtp.safetensors is the multi-token-prediction head (not used at first). Served by vLLM (compose service llm-vllm, read-only mount of llm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4). Revision, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids; the small files hashed after a download at this revision) on 2026-10-07. 26.40 GB. The FP8 group above stays installed and inactive until this one is proven. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=llm-qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.

groups.name: asr-qwen3-asr-1.7b
groups.purpose: Production ASR (producer directive 2026-10-07): Qwen3-ASR-1.7B for English and Arabic speech, dialogue QA, singing and songs with music, subtitle and lyric QA; Whisper large-v3 stays as reference until it is proven. Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B @ 7278e1e7; revision, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids; the small files hashed after a download at this revision) on 2026-10-06. 4.70 GB. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=asr-qwen3-asr-1.7b.

groups.name: align-qwen3-forced-aligner-0.6b
groups.purpose: Production forced aligner for English and the other languages it supports (producer directive 2026-10-07); it does not cover Arabic, where WhisperX-style CTC alignment stays. Qwen/Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B @ c7cbfc20; revision, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids; the small files hashed after a download at this revision) on 2026-10-06. 1.84 GB. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=align-qwen3-forced-aligner-0.6b.

groups.name: sfx-moss-soundeffect-v2
groups.purpose: Production sound effects (producer directive 2026-10-07): MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0, a 1.3B DiT with its text encoder and 48 kHz VAE, for ambience, Foley, footsteps, crowds, weather, doors and cinematic effects; replaces the 8B MOSS-SoundEffect route once a real Vewbox SFX test passes. OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0 @ e35df4d8; revision, bytes and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oids; the small files hashed after a download at this revision) on 2026-10-06. 11.23 GB. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=sfx-moss-soundeffect-v2.

groups.name: music-ace-step-xl-base
groups.purpose: ACE-Step 1.5 XL-Base (4 B DiT, MIT): only for advanced song operations (repaint, cover, extend, extract, complete) when a workflow needs them (producer directive 2026-10-07); split from music-ace-step-xl so the song stack downloads without it. Same pinned entry as before. Not in the default MODEL_GROUPS: MODEL_GROUPS=music-ace-step-xl-base.

groups.name: eval-svc-soulx-singer
groups.purpose: EVALUATION ONLY — NOT PRODUCTION-APPROVED (Phase 3 singer identity, 2026-10-07). ACE-Step's timbre reference moved a sung vocal only partway to a real speaker (ECAPA 0.05 → 0.39), so the minimal production-safe path is evaluated: SoulX-Singer-SVC, zero-shot singing voice conversion (frozen Whisper-base content encoder + F0 encoder + flow-matching decoder; transcription-free; no per-speaker training) — the song's vocal re-voiced by the performer's consented reference. Checks so far: code and weights Apache-2.0 (model card), active (updated 2026-03-13), local. OPEN: training data is a 'large-scale proprietary dataset' (42k+ h, Mandarin/English/Cantonese) with no named sources — provenance needs the producer's legal review; the prompt is meant to be SINGING (speech reference to be tested); Arabic untested; the weights are .pt pickles (loaded only inside an isolated evaluation container). RMVPE (pitch) from the preprocess repo. Revision and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oid; config hashed from its bytes).

groups.name: qa-phoneme-espeak
groups.purpose: THE IRAQI PHONOLOGY GATE (Phase 3, 2026-10-07): wav2vec2 XLSR-53 fine-tuned for multilingual phoneme recognition (IPA, eSpeak set; Apache-2.0), run on the CTC-aligned span of a dialect word to hear WHICH consonant was spoken: چ must come back as tʃ (the historical «باچر» → «باسر» failure is the regression case), گ as ɡ. Spelling-based ASR cannot do this: neither Qwen3-ASR nor Whisper writes چ (Whisper: 0 of 36). Used by the asr service (/qa/phonemes); never generates anything. Revision and sha256 from the Hugging Face API (LFS oid) and the downloaded small files.

groups.name: tts-habibi-irq
groups.purpose: THE IRAQI SPEECH ENGINE (producer decision 2026-10-07): Habibi-TTS Specialized IRQ (F5-TTS v1 Base, 100k steps) for the tts-habibi service, cloned from a character's consented Baghdadi reference. ONLY the Specialized IRQ checkpoint: the model card states Unified, SAU and UAE are CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and ALG, EGY, IRQ, MAR, MSA are Apache 2.0 (read 2026-10-07; repo-level tag cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 covers the Unified model). Revision and sha256 from the files already in the store (the HF download metadata's LFS oid matches). Provenance note kept for legal review: the checkpoint is fine-tuned from F5-TTS v1 Base, whose pretraining data (Emilia) is CC-BY-NC — recorded, not treated as the checkpoint's licence.
